_about: Canonical example payload for POST /api/script/generate (unified endpoint, PR6). Replaces the deprecated POST /api/script/generate-from-clips — same job type 'script.generate_from_clips' under the hood. Single-item envelope V2, text-source (no clip_ids), Italian, 400-word target, save_to_db=false. ALWAYS enabled: generate_document=true so the result includes a Google Doc. Prerequisites: (a) a fresh Drive token at token.json (regenerate with python3 scripts/generate_drive_token.py if missing), (b) a writable destination drive_folder_id (operator-supplied: edit the JSON or export VELOX_DOC_FOLDER=<id-or-url> before running, then this file's items[0].output.drive_folder_id inherits it). NO real folder ids are committed to this file by design. Same proven shape used by tmp/jackie_chen_smoke.py to validate the canonical endpoint end-to-end. Note: _run and _poll are stand-alone one-liners; export BASE once at the shell level if you copy only one of them.
_run: BASE=${VELOX_BROKER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${VELOX_PORT:-8000}}; jq -c --arg df "${VELOX_DOC_FOLDER:-}" '. as $e | del(._about,._run,._poll) | if $df != "" then .items[0].output |= (. + {drive_folder_id:$df}) else . end' examples/scripts/jackie_chan_generate.json | curl -sS -X POST $BASE/api/script/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer ${VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN:-test-admin-token-12345}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Request-ID: jackie-chan-smoke' --data-binary @-
_poll: BASE=${VELOX_BROKER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${VELOX_PORT:-8000}}; curl -s $BASE/api/jobs/<job_id>/full -H "Authorization: Bearer $VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN" | jq -r '.status,.result.script // empty'  # poll every 3s until status in {completed,SUCCEEDED,failed,cancelled}
